'''Deirdru''' was a minor [[Altaran]] noblewoman.

==History==
She was a minor Altaran noblewoman with estates in nothern Altara.

==Activities==
She was the owner of the manor house in which the [[Dragon Reborn]] was to meet with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]. This was, however, a trap set by [[Semirhage]]. It is assumed that the Lady Deirdru was murdered by Semirhage, as evidenced by the several rooms with bloodstained carpets in them.
